summary: GH Research PLC filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, reporting its second quarter 2026 financial results, providing business updates, and making an updated corporate presentation available. The filing includes exhibits of the press release and presentation. It contains no merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction. This is a routine periodic earnings report by a foreign private issuer, with no deal terms or strategic event disclosed. As such, it does not qualify as a special situation under the classification criteria.
